# Error-Handling Checklist: Read-Only Helper Port

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-805 requirements define error-handling parity for read-only helper ports before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-07-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are stdout JSON preservation requirements defined for accepted helper inputs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK002 Are stdout JSON schemas for rejected helper inputs defined for helpers that currently emit machine-readable failure output? [Resolved: Spec §FR-023 and Data Model §Parity Fixture now require rejected stdout schemas where machine-readable failure output exists.]
- [x] CHK003 Are stderr diagnostic preservation requirements defined for accepted and rejected helper inputs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK004 Are exit-code preservation requirements defined for success, advisory, usage, missing-input, and validation-failure cases? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK005 Is a per-helper failure-class to nonzero-exit mapping required for invalid input, missing input, malformed JSON, missing file, unsupported path, prerequisite failure, validation failure, and subprocess/preflight failure where applicable? [Resolved: Spec §FR-024, Plan §Error And Security Requirements, Data Model §Failure Class Mapping, and the promotion-record schema now require exact mappings.]
- [x] CHK006 Are prerequisite and preflight failures included in the in-scope helper and runner behavior? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1, Plan §Slice 1]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is JSON stdout comparison specified as semantic rather than byte-for-byte? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK008 Are stderr diagnostics and exit codes specified as exact comparisons unless an explicit normalization rule applies? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK009 Are allowed environment-sensitive normalization fields explicitly limited? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK010 Are fields that must not be normalized identified clearly enough to prevent hiding behavior drift? [Clarity, Spec §Phase 2 Clarifications, Data Model §Normalization Rule]
- [x] CHK011 Is deterministic remediation text or diagnostic remediation action content required for rejected helper inputs that surface runner diagnostics? [Resolved: Spec §FR-023, Plan §Error And Security Requirements, and Data Model §Parity Fixture now require deterministic remediation text or actions when diagnostics are emitted.]
